ISSUE:
Add a way to export a report as CSV. Users want to open reports in a spreadsheet.

FAIL_TO_PASS TESTS:
tests/test_report.py::test_to_csv_writes_header

--- a/ledger/report.py
+++ b/ledger/report.py
@@ -40,0 +41,6 @@ class Report:

+        writer.writerow(["id", "name", "total_cents"])
